notes.title: EmemeTown Early Access Postponement
notes.content:
[h1]Dear EmemeTown supporters,[/h1]

Thank you for your continued support of EmemeTown.

We are sorry to inform you that the Early Access release of "EmemeTown," initially scheduled for September 25, 2024, has been postponed to [b]June 25, 2025 JST[/b].

[h2]Reasons for the Delay[/h2]

[h3]1. Technical Challenges[/h3]

   We are currently facing technical issues related to AI simulations and LLM costs that may impact your overall gameplay experience. While we are committed to integrating cutting-edge technology, we do not want to prioritize innovation at the expense of the player experience. As a result, we are carefully re-evaluating the balance between technology and game design to ensure an optimal user experience.

[h3]2. PlayTest Implementation [/h3]

   Initially, we considered Early Access as an opportunity to release the game in its developmental stage and gather your feedback to improve it. However, we have realized that players expect an almost finished product during Early Access. Therefore, we have decided to conduct a PlayTest with select members, gather extensive feedback, and improve the game before releasing it as Early Access.

[h2]Current Development Progress and Upcoming Schedule[/h2]

[h3][Completed] July 31: Launch of [url=https://chat.ememe.ai/]EmemeAI[/url][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787308/5e21ffefd91759dd1e07c917fae5e2b58bb0eeb7.jpg[/img]
  - Released the 3D-AI character creation feature as an MVP (Minimum Viable Product)
  - Planning to implement a feature allowing you to export characters from EmemeAI to "EmemeTown"

[h3]October: Major Update to EmemeAI[/h3]
  - Text-to-Speech (TTS) functionality
  - Memory retention for AI characters

[h3]Winter: PlayTest[/h3]
  - Selected members will be invited to participate in the TestPlay of the beta version of "EmemeTown"
  - For those interested in joining the PlayTest, please stay tuned for announcements via [url=https://x.com/EmemeAI]our official X[/url] (formerly Twitter) account and Steam by the end of the year

[h3]2025 Q2: Early Access Release[/h3]


We apologize to everyone who has been eagerly awaiting EmemeTown. Our team is working diligently, and we ask for a little more patience. We hope you'll look forward to future updates.

Thank you for your understanding and continued support.

Sincerely,  
The EmemeTown Development Team
